title: Fast Relax-and-Round Unit Commitment with Economic Horizons
summary: The US energy system is under increasing pressure to serve expanding data centers loads and to accommodate a larger number of generating units with varying technologies and ownership structures. Therefore, developing new unit commitment (UC) methods remains a priority for reliable and affordable grid operations. We expand our novel computational method for UC to include ramping constraints and long-horizon planning, and provide a theoretical bound on its accuracy.
